sequence.description: Ancient door jingle as bros enter

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Ah, Americans. Wanting to see the countryside, are ye?

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.dialogue: Yeah, we want the full Irish experience. Open roads. Green hills. Sheep.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Have ye driven on the left before?

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.dialogue: How hard can it be? It's just... mirror image.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: *thousand-yard stare*

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: That's what they all say.

sequence.speaker: bradley
sequence.dialogue: I've studied the road system extensively. I printed directions from Mapquest.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: ...Mapquest.

sequence.speaker: chadwick
sequence.dialogue: And we have GPS on our phones.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: God help ye.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: *sliding keys across counter*

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: God help ye. Especially at the Cloverleaf.

sequence.speaker: lord_pilsner
sequence.dialogue: The what?

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Ye'll see. Everyone sees. Eventually.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Will ye be wanting the GPS? The insurance? The map? ...The rosary?

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Sign here. And here. And... here.
sequence.note: Fine print mentions 'circular traffic incidents not covered'

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: *sliding keys across counter* Good luck out there.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Remember. Just slow down. That's all it takes.

sequence.description: Bros in rental car, pulling out of gravel lot
Seamus visible through window, thousand-yard stare
sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: *watching silently*

sequence.description: Country road stretching toward The Cloverleaf

sequence.speaker: gps
sequence.dialogue: In five hundred meters, enter the roundabout.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Ye made it out.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Most don't, ye know. At least not with their sanity.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Ye've earned my respect. Doesn't mean much. But ye've earned it.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: Tell ye what. Ten percent off next time. Not that ye'll be wanting to drive again.

sequence.speaker: seamus
sequence.dialogue: The flashbacks fade. Eventually. The GPS voice never really leaves ye, though. 'Recalculating.'

interactive_objects.description: A corkboard covered in Polaroid photos of abandoned rental cars. Different makes, models, years. International license plates. Some have notes: 'Still circling.' 'Found empty.' 'Gave up.' One empty spot has a note: 'Reserved for next.'
interactive_objects.seamus_comment: Forty years of them. Some found their way out. Some... joined the circulation.

detailed_examination.1987_van: A faded photo of a minivan with 'JUST MARRIED 1987' visible. Note: 'Still circling. Raised family inside. Grandchildren now.'
detailed_examination.german_sedan: 1995 German plates. Note: 'Found empty. Driver never located.'
detailed_examination.american_rental: License plate: 'VACAY-1'. Note: 'Returned by AAA. Driver hospitalized for shock.'
detailed_examination.reserved_spot: Empty polaroid frame. Note in Seamus's handwriting: 'Reserved for next. There's always a next.'

interactive_objects.description: 'DAYS SINCE LAST CLOVERLEAF INCIDENT' mounted on wall. The number reads 000. Thick layer of dust suggests it hasn't been changed in decades. Small print at bottom: 'Record: 0 (achieved every day since 1984)'
interactive_objects.seamus_comment: Aye, it's stuck on zero. Has been for forty years. It's not broken. There's just always an incident. Every. Single. Day.

interactive_objects.interaction_text: Examine the map on the wall
interactive_objects.description: A standard road map of Publandia. One area is circled aggressively in red marker. The handwritten label reads: 'HERE BE DRAGONS'. Several routes to and around the circle have been drawn and crossed out.
detailed_notes: The scenic route: Also leads here

interactive_objects.interaction_text: Look at the photo on Seamus's desk
interactive_objects.description: A silver frame holds a photo of a younger woman with a warm smile. The back of the frame, barely visible, reads: 'MARY - CLOVERLEAF '92'

if_asked_more.speaker: seamus
if_asked_more.dialogue: She went for a quick drive in '92. 'Just to see the cliffs,' she said. The car came back. She didn't.
if_asked_more.follow_up: They say she's still circling. I like to think she's happy.

interactive_objects.description: A beige computer tower and CRT monitor running what appears to be Windows 98. The screen shows a rental database frozen mid-update. The last entry timestamp: 1999.
interactive_objects.easter_egg: The screensaver, when it activates, shows a car driving in an endless circle.

interactive_objects.description: Rows of car keys on hooks. Some hooks are empty. Others have keys that look like they haven't been touched in years. A few have small notes: 'Returned', 'Abandoned', 'Circling'.
interactive_objects.note: One key has a tag reading 'MARY - '92' and is clearly never used.

interactive_objects.description: Faded 'VISIT PUBLANDIA' posters showing scenic coastal roads and green hillsides. One has been defaced with marker: 'DON'T' written before 'VISIT'. Another shows a roundabout symbol with a skull drawn over it.

easter_eggs.description: Crumpled Mapquest printouts in the trash. Dozens of them. All showing routes to the same destination. All useless.
A drawer full of returned GPS devices. When examined, several still display 'RECALCULATING' burned into their screens permanently.
Occasionally a sheep appears in the window, staring directly at the player. It knows.

narrator_commentary.on_entering: Paddy's Premium Motors. Where dreams of the open Irish road come to die.
narrator_commentary.on_seamus_stare: Seamus had seen too much. Forty years of watching tourists drive toward The Cloverleaf. Forty years of warnings ignored.
narrator_commentary.on_board_of_shame: Forty years of them. Some came back. Some didn't. The board kept growing.
narrator_commentary.on_rental_completion: The keys slid across the counter with a finality that Seamus knew all too well. Another sacrifice for The Cloverleaf.
narrator_commentary.on_departure: They drove east, toward The Cloverleaf, as everyone eventually does. Seamus watched them go. He always watched them go.
